picture-pairs.name: Amafoto ahuje
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Umukino wo guhuza amashusho ku bantu bakuru: Amashusho ahuje
picture-pairs.h1: Amafoto ahuje: umukino woroshye wo guhuza
picture-pairs.description: Umukino woroheje kandi utuje wo guhuza, ku bantu bakuru n'abakuze, harimo n'abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa. Amashusho ashobora gukomeza kugaragara. Nta gihe cyo kubarira cyangwa amanota.
picture-pairs.short: Shakisha amafoto abiri asa. Amafoto ashobora kuguma agaragara.
picture-pairs.intro: Kanda ifoto, hanyuma ukande iyisa nayo. Amafoto aguma agaragara ku buryo busanzwe, bityo nta cyo musabwa kwibuka. Iyo amafoto abiri ahuje, ahabwa umupaka wa zahabu n'ikimenyetso cyo kwemeza.
howTo: Hitamo umubare w'ibice ukoresha. Ibice bine ni ahantu hatuje ho gutangirira.
Kanda ifoto iyo ari yo yose. Ihabwa umupaka wa zahabu.
Kanda ifoto isa na yo. Ayo mafoto abiri aguma hamwe afite ikimenyetso cyo kwemeza.
Niba amafoto abiri atandukanye, nta kibi kibaho. Kanda ukundi igihe witeguye.
Fungura “Amafoto yihishe” gusa niba mwembi mukunda uburyo bwa kera bw'amafoto ahindukiriye hasi.
tips: Vuga amazina y'amafoto hamwe, muganire kuri yo: “Igikombe cy'icyayi gitukura. Wakunda icyayi n'amata?”
Reka umuntu witaho ni we ukanda, nubwo byatwara igihe. Mumwereke ukoresheje urutoki aho kumukandira.
Gumana n'ibice bine igihe cyose bikinogeye. Ibice byinshi ni amahitamo, si urwego rwo kugeraho.
Rangiza igikorwa igihe kikiri gishimishije. Umukino umwe ni igikorwa cyuzuye.

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara ingendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Kuki amafoto aguma agaragara?
faq.a: Kugumisha amafoto agaragara bihindura umukino ukaba uwo kureba no guhuza aho kuba uwo kwibuka. Benshi babona ko bituma biruhura. Mushobora guhindura mukajya ku mafoto yihishe mu kanda kamwe niba mubishaka.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, ntihakenewe konti, kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora muri mushakisha y'interineti ku telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

faq.q: Dushobora gukoresha amafoto yacu y'umuryango?
faq.a: Yego. Gerageza “Amafoto ahuje” ahereye ku mafoto muhitamo ava ku gikoresho cyanyu. Amafoto aguma muri mushakisha yanyu ntiyoherezwa ahandi.

find-the-same.name: Shakisha ifoto imwe
find-the-same.seoTitle: Shakisha ifoto imeze kimwe: Umukino woroshye w'amashusho
find-the-same.description: Ifoto imwe iri hejuru, ebyiri kugeza kuri enye ziri hepfo. Kanda ifoto imeze kimwe. Ni umukino w'amashusho utuje kandi ku buntu, ku bantu bakuru, abakuze n'imiryango, nta gihe cyo kubarira.
find-the-same.short: Reba ifoto iri hejuru, hanyuma ukande isa nayo iri hepfo.
find-the-same.intro: Ifoto imwe iri hejuru ya ecran. Munsi yayo hari ebyiri, eshatu cyangwa enye. Kanda isa na yo. Ni uguhitamo rimwe rimwe, hari umwanya uhagije wo kuganira.
howTo: Hitamo amafoto abiri, atatu cyangwaane yo guhitamo. Abiri ni yo yoroshye kurusha.
Reba hamwe ifoto iri hejuru.
Kanda ifoto isa na yo iri hepfo. Ihabwa ikimenyetso cyo kwemeza n'amagambo make meza.
Niba hakanzwe ifoto itari yo, umukino uvuga gusa izina ryayo ugategereza. Fata umwanya wawe.
Kanda “Ifoto ikurikiraho” igihe witeguye indi.
tips: Ganira ku ifoto yose mbere yo guhitamo: amabara, imiterere, aho wayibona.
Guhitamo hagati y'ibintu bibiri ntibivuga ko “byoroshye cyane”. Intego ni akanya keza, si ikibazo.
Niba gukanda bigoye, umuntu ashobora kwerekana, nawe ukamukandira.

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara ingendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Bigenda gute iyo hakanzwe ifoto itari yo?
faq.a: Nta kibi kibaho. Nta buzzer, nta gikoze gitukura cyangwa kunyeganyega. Umukino uvuga ifoto yakanzwe ugategereza igikanda gikurikiraho.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, ntihakenewe konti, kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora muri mushakisha y'interineti ku telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

shadow-match.name: Guhuza igicucu
shadow-match.seoTitle: Umukino wo guhuza igicucu: Ku buntu kuri interineti ku bantu bakuru
shadow-match.description: Igicucu cyijimye kiri hejuru, amashusho ebyiri kugeza kuri enye ari hepfo. Kanda ifoto itanga icyo gicucu. Ni umukino utuje wo guhuza igicucu, ku buntu, nta gihe cyo kubarira.
shadow-match.short: Reba igicucu hanyuma ukande ifoto ikora icyo gicucu.
shadow-match.intro: Guhuza igicucu ni igikorwa kizwi mu mpapuro zicapwe, hano hari amafoto manini kandi nta cyo gucapa. Igicucu cyoroshye kiri hejuru ya ecran, hanyuma amafoto abiri, atatu cyangwaane ari hepfo. Kanda ifoto itanga icyo gicucu. Ibintu nk'igare, umutaka cyangwa igikombe cy'icyayi nabyo byoroshye kubiganiraho.
howTo: Hitamo amafoto abiri, atatu cyangwaane yo guhitamo. Abiri ni yo yoroshye kurusha.
Reba hamwe igicucu. Ni imiterere ki? Ni kirekire cyangwa ni kizengurutse?
Kanda ifoto itanga icyo gicucu. Izina ryayo ryerekanwa munsi y'igicucu.
Niba hakanzwe ifoto itari yo, umukino uvuga gusa izina ryayo ugategereza. Fata umwanya wawe.
Kanda “Igicucu gikurikiraho” igihe witeguye ikindi.
tips: Kurikirana ku rutoki umurongo w'igicucu, maze muganire ku miterere yacyo.
Niba igicucu kigoye uyu munsi, hindukirira “Shakisha ifoto imwe”, aho amafoto asa neza.
Ganira ku ifoto igihe iboneka: “Twari dufite umutaka usa n'uyu.”

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara ingendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa bashobora kwishimira umukino wo guhuza igicucu?
faq.a: Abantu bakuru benshi barawishimira, harimo bamwe mu bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, akenshi mu ntangiriro y'indwara. Ibibumbano byoroha kubimenya kurusha amagambo. Ni uburyo bwo kwishimira no kuganira, si ikizamini, kandi ntikivura cyangwa ngo gitinde indwara yo kwibagirwa. Niba bikubabaza, gerageza “Shakisha ifoto imeze kimwe” cyangwa mwitegereze amashusho hamwe gusa.

faq.q: Ni iki kibaho iyo bakanze ishusho itari yo?
faq.a: Nta kintu kibabaje kibaho. Nta buzzer, nta musaraba utukura, nta kunyeganyega. Umukino uvuga ishusho yakanzwe kandi ugategereza gukanda ikurikira.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora mu mushakisha w'urubuga kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

four-together.name: Enye hamwe
four-together.seoTitle: Umukino wo guhuriza hamwe amashusho ku bantu bakuru: Enye hamwe
four-together.h1: Enye hamwe: Umukino utuje wo guhuriza hamwe amashusho
four-together.description: Amashusho amwe asangiye insanganyamatsiko, nk'imbuto cyangwa ikirere. Kanda ayajyana. Ni umukino wo guhuriza hamwe utuje kandi ku buntu, nta gihe cyo kubarira n'nta manota.
four-together.short: Shakisha amashusho ajyana, nk'imbuto cyangwa ikirere.
four-together.intro: Ni itsinda rito ry'amashusho, kandi amwe muri yo arajyana: nk'imbuto enye, cyangwa uburyo bune bwo kugenda. Kanda amashusho asangiye insanganyamatsiko imwe. Iyo ifoto itajyana n'izindi, umukino uyivuga gusa ukategereza. Nyuma y'akanya gatuje, igitekerezo kivuga insanganyamatsiko, kandi “Erekana itsinda” igaragaza igisubizo igihe cyose ubishakiye.
howTo: Mutoranye amashusho enye, atandatu cyangwa umunani. Enye ni yo yoroheje, harimo eshatu zijyana.
Mwitegereze amashusho hamwe, murebe ibyo bisangiye.
Kanda buri shusho ijyanye n'itsinda. Izahabwa umupaka wa zahabu n'akamenyetso k'ukuri.
Iyo ifoto ijyana n'ikindi, umukino urabivuga ugategereza. Mufate umwanya wanyu.
Kanda “Erekana itsinda” igihe cyose ubishakiye, hanyuma “Andi mashusho” ku mashusho mashya.
tips: Vuga ibyo ubona mu ijwi riranguruye: “Ibi byombi ni ibyo kurya.”
Nta gikwiye kwihuta. Igitekerezo kivuga insanganyamatsiko kigaragara nyuma y'akanya, kandi ushobora kukirengagiza.
Mugire icyo muvuga ku itsinda rimaze kuboneka: imbuto ukunda, urugendo rwa gari ya moshi, cyangwa ikirere cyo uyu munsi.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyo kubarira cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'intambwe, kandi nta gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarika hagati nabyo ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Iyo hakanzwe ifoto itari mu itsinda, byagenda bite?
faq.a: Nta kibi kibaho. Nta buzzer, umusaraba utukura cyangwa kunyeganyega. Umukino uvuga iyo foto, ukavuga ko ijyana n'izindi, kandi ugategereza ikanda rikurikira.

faq.q: Amatsinda ni ayahe?
faq.a: Ni insanganyamatsiko zo mu buzima bwa buri munsi, zitagusaba ubumenyi bwihariye: imbuto, inyamaswa, indabyo, ikirere, uburyo bwo kugenda, ibijyana n'ikinyobwa gishyushye n'ibiteka mu ifuru. Buri shusho ni iy'itsinda rimwe gusa.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ku buntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo ikintu. Ukora mu rubuga rwa interineti kuri telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

odd-one-out.name: Itandukanye
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Umukino w'ifoto itandukanye ku bantu bakuru

faq.a: Amashusho akomoka ku nsanganyamatsiko zo mu buzima bwa buri munsi, zitagusaba ubumenyi bwihariye: imbuto, inyamaswa, indabyo, ikirere, uburyo bwo kugenda, ibijyana n'ikinyobwa gishyushye n'ibiteka mu ifuru. color-match.name: Guhuza amabara
color-match.h1: Guhuza amabara: shakisha amashusho y’ibara rimwe
color-match.description: Ibara rinini rifite izina ryaryo, n’amashusho ane cyangwa atandatu. Kanda buri shusho ifite icyo kara. Nta gihe cyagenwe, nta manota, kandi irindi bara rivugwa gusa izina ryaryo. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
color-match.short: Shakisha amashusho yose afite ibara rimwe n’iryerekanwe.
color-match.players: Abantu 1 cyangwa 2, cyangwa umuntu mukuru n’umwana
color-match.intro: Hagaragara agace kanini k’ibara, izina ryaryo rikaba ryanditse iruhande rwako, naho munsi yaho hakaba amashusho ane cyangwa atandatu. Kanda buri shusho ifite iryo bara: urugero, pome itukura n’igikombe gitukura. Niba shusho ifite irindi bara, umukino uvuga ibara ryayo gusa (“Ipera ni icyatsi.”) maze utegereze. Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, “Ubereke” yerekana amashusho ahuye, na “Irindi bara” igasimbuza ibara.
howTo: Hitamo amashusho ane cyangwa atandatu. Ane ni yo yoroshye kurusha.
Reba ibara hamwe, musome izina ryaryo.
Kanda buri shusho ifite iryo bara. Buri imwe ihabwa umupaka munini n’akamenyetso ko kugenzura.
Niba shusho ifite irindi bara, umukino uvuga ibara ryayo kandi utegereze. Fata igihe cyawe.
Kanda “Ubereke” igihe cyose ushaka, hanyuma “Irindi bara” kugira ngo ubone ibara rishya.
tips: Vuga ibara mu ijwi rirenga, hanyuma urebe mu cyumba: ni ibihe bindi bintu bifite iryo bara?
Koresha amagambo yawe niba ubishaka. “Inyanya” cyangwa “ikirere” ni byiza nka “umutuku” cyangwa “ubururu”.
Kwerekana n’intoki nabyo birakora nko gukanda. Mwicare iruhande rwanyu kugira ngo mwembi mubone ecran.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara intambwe cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Bigenda bite iyo ukanze ishusho y’irindi bara?
faq.a: Nta kintu kibabaza. Nta buzzer, nta akamenyetso k’ikosa gatukura cyangwa kunyeganyega. Umukino uvuga izina ry’ishusho n’ibara ryayo, nk’“Ipera ni icyatsi.”, maze ugategereza gukanda gukurikiyeho.

faq.q: Ese ibara ni ryo rifasha gusa?
faq.a: Oya. Ibara rigaragazwa nk’agace kanini kandi rikandikwa nk’ijambo, kandi buri shusho ivugwa izina iyo ikanzwe. Umuntu ubona amabara bigoranye ashobora gukina asoma izina.

faq.q: Ese buri shusho koko ifite ibyo bara?
faq.a: Amashusho atoranywa n’intoki, gusa ayo ikintu nyamukuru kigaragara ko ari ibara rimwe. Amashusho afite amabara menshi, nk’igisabo cy’umuyaga cyangwa inzuki, ntiyashyizwemo.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku mpapuro?
faq.a: Yego. Urupapuro rumwe rufite imirongo ine. Buri murongo utanga izina ry’ibara kandi ugaragaza amashusho ane yo kwerekana cyangwa kuzengurukaho.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi ndakenera kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora mu mushakisha y’urubuga kuri telefoni, kuri tablet cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

halves-match.name: Guhuza ibice
halves-match.h1: Guhuza ibice: huza ibice bibiri by’ishusho
halves-match.description: Ibice by’ibumoso by’amashusho abiri cyangwa atatu biri ku ruhande rumwe, ibice by’iburyo biri ku rundi. Kanda igice, hanyuma ukande igice kibihuza. Nta gihe cyagenwe, nta manota, kandi ibice bitahuye bitandukana gusa. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
halves-match.short: Kanda ibice bibiri bihuye bikore ishusho imwe.
halves-match.players: Abantu 1 cyangwa 2, cyangwa umuntu mukuru n’umwana
halves-match.intro: Buri shusho icibwa hagati. Ibice by’ibumoso by’amashusho abiri cyangwa atatu biri ku nkingi imwe, naho ibice by’iburyo, mu rundi rutonde, biri ku yindi. Kanda igice cy’ibumoso, hanyuma ukande igice cy’iburyo kihuye na cyo, nk’umunwa w’ikibindi n’ikiganza cyacyo. Ibice bihuye bihurizwa hamwe bikora ishusho yuzuye. Ibice bitahuye bitandukana none, kandi umukino ubivuga mu buryo bworoheje. “Mbereke” ihuza byose.
howTo: Hitamo amashusho abiri cyangwa atatu. Abiri ni yo yoroshye kurusha.
Reba hamwe ibice by’ibumoso. Utekereza ko buri kimwe ari igice cy’iki?
Kanda igice cy’ibumoso, hanyuma ukande igice cy’iburyo kihuye na cyo. Ushobora no gukora mu buryo bunyuranye.
Ibice bihuye bihurizwa hamwe, bifite umupaka munini n’akamenyetso ko kugenzura. Ibitahuye bitandukana none, kandi ushobora kugerageza ibindi.
Kanda “Mbereke” igihe cyose ushaka, hanyuma “Andi mashusho” kugira ngo ubone amashusho mashya.
tips: Kurikirana umupaka w’igice n’urutoki. Igishushanyo kigera he hagati?
Vuga ibyo ubona: “Iki gifite ikiganza.” Ntibikenewe kuvuga izina rya buri shusho.
Kwerekana n’intoki nabyo birakora nko gukanda. Mwicare iruhande rwanyu kugira ngo mwembi mubone ecran.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara intambwe cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Bigenda bite iyo ibice bibiri bitahuye?
faq.a: Nta kintu kibabaza. Nta buzzer, nta akamenyetso k’ikosa gatukura cyangwa kunyeganyega. Ibice bibiri bitandukana none, kandi umukino uravuga uti: “Ibyo bibiri ntibihuye. Gerageza ibindi.” Nta kintu kibarwa.

faq.q: Ese amashusho aroroshye gutandukanya?
faq.a: Yego. Amashusho atoranywa n’intoki, kandi amashusho abiri ku kibaho kimwe ntaturuka mu itsinda rimwe, nk’imbuto ebyiri cyangwa inyamaswa ebyiri. Amashusho ibice byayo byombi bisa, nk’izuba cyangwa umukororombya, ntiyashyizwemo.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku mpapuro?
faq.a: Yego. Urupapuro rumwe rugira igice cy'ibumoso cy'amashusho 3 mu kiyunguruzo kimwe, n'igice cy'iburyo cyayo, gitondetse mu bundi buryo, mu kindi kiyunguruzo. Shushanya umurongo uhuza buri gice cy'ibumoso n'igice cy'iburyo kibihuje.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta no gukuramo bisabwa. Ikora mu mushakisha y'urubuga kuri telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

color-by-number.name: Amabara ukurikije imibare
color-by-number.seoTitle: Amabara ukurikije imibare: umukino utuje wo kuzuza ufite inyuguti nini
color-by-number.h1: Amabara ukurikije imibare: zuzuza utuntu, ukoreshe ibara ryose ushaka
color-by-number.description: Ikibaho cy'utuntu tunini twanditseho imibare, hamwe n'urutonde rw'amabara ane n'amazina yayo. Hitamo ibara, hanyuma ukande utuntu kugira ngo ubuzuze. Ibara ryose rirakwiye, nta isaha, nta manota, kandi buto imwe izuzuza ibisigaye ukurikije imibare. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
color-by-number.short: Hitamo ibara, hanyuma ukande utuntu twanditseho imibare kugira ngo ubuzuze.
color-by-number.intro: Ikibaho cy'utuntu tunini tw'amakare, buri kamwe gafite umubare, n'urutonde hejuru yacyo rurimo amabara ane, buri ryose rifite umubare waryo n'izina ryaryo ryanditse. Hitamo ibara ku rutonde, hanyuma ukande utuntu kugira ngo ubuzuze. Ikibaho gitangira ari 4 kuri 4, kandi gishobora kuba 6 kuri 6 cyangwa 8 kuri 8 igihe ushaka utuntu twinshi. Iyo utuntu twose tugize ibara ry'umubare wabo, ikibaho kiba ishusho yo ku rupapuro. Utuntu tuzuzwa ibindi bara ni ishusho yawe bwite, kandi umukino ntuvuga iby'ibyo na gato. "Uzuza ukurikije imibare" yuzuza utuntu twose tutarimo ibara.
howTo: Hitamo ingano y'ikibaho. 4 kuri 4 ifite utuntu tunini kurusha izindi kandi ni yo yoroshye.
Reba urutonde ruri hejuru y'ikibaho. Buri bara rifite umubare n'izina, nk'aho 1 Umuhondo.
Kanda ibara ku rutonde, hanyuma ukande utuntu wifuza kuzuza ryo.
Koresha ibara rifite umubare, cyangwa ibara ryose ushaka. Byombi ni byiza.
Kanda "Uzuza ukurikije imibare" ku tuntu tutarimo ibara, "Siba" kugira ngo utangire ikibaho bushya, cyangwa "Ishusho indi" kugira ngo ubone indi.
tips: Mwicare iruhande rumwe, mufatane umwanya: umwe ahitamo ibara, undi akande akanya.
Muvugane ku mabara: "Nkunda icyatsi." Ntibikenewe kuvuga ishusho izaba.
Ku ruhande rufunganye, ikibaho cya 8 kuri 8 kizimuka uruhande mu gasanduku kacyo. Utuntu tuguma ari tunini ku buryo bworoshye.
Verisiyo yo ku rupapuro na yo ikora neza, n'amakaramu ku meza iruhande rw'uburiri.

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?

faq.q: Ese byagenda gute nkoresheje ibara ritari irya nimero?
faq.a: Nta kibaho, kandi ibyo ni cyo kigamijwe. Ibara ryose rishobora kujya mu kantu kose, kandi umukino ntuvuga iby'ibyo na gato. Iyo utuntu twose tugize ibara ry'umubare wabo, umukino ubivuga buhoro, kandi ishusho mu mabara yawe bwite na yo ni nziza kimwe.

faq.q: Ese abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutamenya amabara bashobora gutandukanya amabara ane?
faq.a: Yatoranyijwe kugira ngo abe ayo. Buri bara rifite kandi umubare, izina ryanditse n'ishusho yaryo ntoya, bityo ibara ntirigenewe kuba ryonyine uburyo bwo kuryitandukanya. Uruhererekane rw'amabara ane rwasuzumwe hakoreshejwe ibigereranyo by'ubumuga bwo kutamenya umutuku n'icyatsi, n'ubwo kutamenya ubururu n'umuhondo, kandi binatandukanye mu rumuri. Umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutamenya amabara ntarabigerageza, ni yo mpamvu tubwire niba bibiri muri byo bisa.

faq.q: Utuntu ni tunini bihagije ku muntu ufite guhinda cyangwa ku ikoranabuhanga rito?
faq.a: Buri kantu gapima nibura pikseli 48 mu bugari, na 56 ku kibaho cya 4 kuri 4. Iyo ikibaho kiri kinini ku ikoranabuhanga, kizimuka uruhande mu gasanduku kacyo aho guto utuntu.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku rupapuro?
faq.a: Yego. Urupapuro rumwe rugira ikibaho cyanditseho imibare, n'urutonde rw'amabara ane hamwe n'amazina yayo. Shushanya buri kantu ukoresheje ikaramu y'ibara rifite umubare waryo, cyangwa ibara ryose ushaka.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta no gukuramo bisabwa. Ikora mu mushakisha y'urubuga kuri telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

pattern-maker.name: Uwukora igishushanyo
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Uwukora igishushanyo: shushanya akagarurwa maze ucapishe igishushanyo
pattern-maker.h1: Uwukora igishushanyo: shushanya akagarurwa, urebe uko gasubirwamo
pattern-maker.description: Hindura utuntu tw'akagarurwa gato maze urebe uko gasubirwamo kakagira igishushanyo kiri iruhande rwako, mu mabara ane afite izina n'ishusho byayo. Nta isaha, nta manota. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
pattern-maker.short: Hindura utuntu tw'akagarurwa gato maze urebe uko gasubirwamo kakagira igishushanyo.
pattern-maker.intro: Akagarurwa gato k'utuntu 3 kuri 3, cyangwa 4 kuri 4 niba ubishaka, kandi iruhande rwako hari "igishushanyo cyawe": akagarurwa kamwe gasubirwamo mu gice kimwe. Kanda akantu, gahinduke ibara rikurikiyeho mu mabara ane, buri ryose rifite izina ryaryo ryanditse n'ishusho yaryo. Igishushanyo kiri iruhande rwako gihinduka ako kanya. Nta gishushanyo gikwiye cyane, kandi nta kibikwa cyangwa ngo kigere ahandi. "Caputsha igishushanyo cyanjye" ishyira igishushanyo cyasubiwemo ku rupapuro rumwe kugira ngo ukibike, ukisige amabara cyangwa ukiture undi.
howTo: Reba akagarurwa n'igishushanyo cyawe kiri iruhande rwako. Ni akagarurwa kamwe, gasubirwamo.
Kanda akantu. Gahinduka ibara rikurikiyeho ku rutonde rw'amabara ane hejuru.
Komeza gukanda utuntu kugeza igishushanyo kikubereye. Igishushanyo cyose ni cyiza.
Kanda "Mpa ikindi gitunguranye" ku kagarurwa gashya, cyangwa "Tangira bushya" ku kagarurwa k'ubusa. "Subiza ibyari byo" igarura akagarurwa wari ufite.
Kanda "Caputsha igishushanyo cyanjye" niba ukifuza ku rupapuro, cyangwa kanda Ruhuka kugira ngo uhagarike.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta mubare w'intambwe cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati na byo ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Ibyo nkoze bibikwa cyangwa bioherezwa?
faq.a: Oya. Akadomo kawe gasigara kuri iyi paje gusa. Ntikabikwa, ntikoherezwa cyangwa ngo kabarwe, kandi kazima igihe ufunze paje. Niba ushaka kubika igishushanyo, gicapishe.

faq.q: Nakanze akabanza nabi cyangwa nkakuraho akadomo nta kubishaka?
faq.a: Nta kanze nabi: kanda none kugira ngo ujye ku ibara ryakurikiyeho. Nyuma ya "Tangira bundi bushya" cyangwa "Ntunyure", "Gusubiza" bigarura akadomo wari ufite.

faq.q: Abantu batabona neza amabara bashobora gutandukanya amabara ane?
faq.a: Yatoranyijwe kugira ngo bibe bityo. Buri bara rifite kandi izina ryanditse n'ishusho ntoya yaryo mu buri kibanza, ku buryo ibara ritari ryo gusa uburyo bwo kubatandukanya. Amabara ane yagenzuwe hifashishijwe imigererageze y'uko abantu batabona neza umutuku n'icyatsi, n'ubururu n'umuhondo. Umuntu udashobora kubona neza amabara ntarabigerageza, ni yo mpamvu mudusabe kubimenyesha niba amabiri asa.

faq.q: Ese ibibanza ni binini bihagije ku muntu ufite guhinda cyangwa ku ecran ntoya?
faq.a: Buri kibanza gifite nibura pigiseli 56 z'ubugari. Niba akadomo karenze ecran, kanyerera uruhande ku ruhande mu gasanduku kacyo aho gutuma ibibanza bigabanuka.

faq.q: Hari uburyo bw'impapuro?
faq.a: Yego. "Caphisha igishushanyo cyanjye" icapisha igishushanyo wakoze ku rupapuro rumwe, hamwe n'amabara ane n'amazina yayo, bikaba byiza no mu mukara n'umweru kuko buri bara rifite ishusho yaryo.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo. Akora mu mushakisha w'urubuga kuri telefoni, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

drawing-duet.name: Gushushanya mu ibaruwa ebyiri
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Gushushanya mu Duet: Abantu Babiri, Igishushanyo Kimwe
drawing-duet.h1: Gushushanya mu Duet: Abantu Babiri, Urupapuro Rumwe
drawing-duet.description: Abantu babiri basimburana gushushanya imirongo ku mwenda umwe usangiwe, buri wese mu ibara rye. Nta wubara amanota cyangwa ngo atsinde, kandi igishushanyo gishobora kubikwa cyangwa gucapwa. Ni ubuntu gukina, nta konti isabwa.
drawing-duet.short: Simburana n'umuntu uri iruhande rwawe mu gushushanya igishushanyo kimwe.
drawing-duet.intro: Umwenda umwe, abantu babiri. Buri wese muri mwe ahitamo ibara, kandi buri bara rifite izina ryaryo ryanditse. Musimburana: mushushanya umurongo umwe cyangwa ishusho imwe, hanyuma mugatanga ikaramu. Buri wese muri mwe ashobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Nta gishushanyo gikwiye cyangwa amanota. Bika igishushanyo ku gikoresho cyawe niba ugikunze, cyangwa ucapishe verisiyo y'impapuro: urupapuro rumwe, ikaramu ebyiri.
howTo: Buri wese muri mwe ahitamo ibara. Ikibaho cyerekana uwo ari igihe cyo gushushanya, hamwe n'izina ry'ibara rye.
Shushanya umurongo umwe cyangwa ishusho imwe ukoresheje urutoki, imbeba cyangwa ikaramu. Cyangwa koresha imyambi n'urufunguzo rwa Space ushushanya utakoresheje pointer.
Nucyo witeguye, kanda "Tanga ikaramu". Buri wese muri mwe ashobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
Kanda "Kuraho umurongo wanjye wa nyuma" kugira ngo ukureho umurongo mushya w'uwo ari igihe cyo gushushanya.
Kanda "Bika igishushanyo" kugira ngo ubike ifoto ku gikoresho cyawe, cyangwa "Caphisha verisiyo y'impapuro" ku rupapuro rumwe n'ikaramu ebyiri.
tips: Mwicare iruhande rumwe mugire icyo muvugana mu gihe mushushanya: "Nzongeramo izuba mu nguni."
Tangira n'akadomo, umurongo cyangwa ishusho yoroshye, maze undi muntu agisubize.
Nta wugomba gushushanya ikintu runaka. Igishushanyo cy'imirongo ni cyiza nk'ikirere.
Niba ushaka guhagarara, kanda "Birarangiye ubu". Igishushanyo cyawe ntikibikwa igihe usohotse kuri paje keretse ukibitse.

faq.q: Hari utsinda cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta watsinze, nta manota, nta isaha, nta kubara ingendo. Nta gishushanyo gikwiye, kandi nta cyashyirwa mu manota cyangwa ngo kigereranywe.

faq.q: Igishushanyo kibikwa cyangwa kirungikwa?
faq.a: Oya, nta kintu koherezwa ahandi. Igishushanyo kiguma kuri iyi paje kugeza ufunze. Niba ukanze Bika igishushanyo, dosiye ikorwa ku gikoresho cyawe kugira ngo ukuremo. Nta kintu gishyirwa ku murongo.

faq.q: Nshobora gukuraho umurongo?
faq.a: Yego. "Kuraho umurongo wanjye wa nyuma" ukuraho umurongo mushya w'uwo ari igihe cyo gushushanya. "Tangira bundi bushya" usukura umwenda, naho "Gusubiza" bigarura imirongo, intambwe imwe gusa.

faq.q: Nshobora kubikoresha ntakoresheje imbeba cyangwa ecran ikoraho?
faq.a: Yego. Igihe igishushanyo kiri ku isonga, imyambi yimura akadomo k'ikaramu, naho urufunguzo rwa Space rushyira ikaramu hasi cyangwa hejuru. Ecran ivuga "Ikaramu hasi" cyangwa "Ikaramu hejuru" buri gihe.

faq.q: Amabara ni ayahe, kandi abantu batabona neza amabara bashobora kuyatandukanya?
faq.a: Umuhondo, orange, icyatsi n'umuvuduko, ayo mabara ane kimwe n'ayakoreshejwe mu yindi mikino yacu y'amashusho. Buri rimwe rifite izina ryanditse, kandi amazina agaragara iruhande rw'igihe cyo gushushanya. Amabara yagenzuwe hifashishijwe imigererageze y'itandukaniro risanzwe mu kubona amabara, ariko umuntu utandukanye mu kubona amabara ntarabigerageza.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo y'impapuro?
faq.a: Yego. "Caphisha verisiyo y'impapuro" icapisha urupapuro rumwe rurimo amategeko n'ikibanza kinini cy'ubusa cyo gushushanyamo, ku bantu babiri bafite ikaramu ebyiri. Bikora no mu mukara n'umweru.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Ee, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo. Ikora ku rubuga rw'urubuga ku telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

build-together.name: Kubaka hamwe
build-together.seoTitle: Kubaka Hamwe: Abantu Babiri Bubaka Igishushanyo Kimwe
build-together.h1: Kubaka Hamwe: Abantu Babiri, Akarere Kamwe
build-together.description: Abantu babiri bafata imvugo yo gushyira agace kabo mu gakoni gasangiwe kugeza gasigaye, buri wese afite ibara rye rifite izina n'ishusho yaryo. Nta muntu utsinda, nta isaha cyangwa amanota. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
build-together.short: Fata imvugo n'umuntu muri iruhande rwawe wuzuze akarere kamwe gasangiwe.
build-together.intro: Akarere gasangiwe k'imyanya 4 kuri 4, cyangwa 3 kuri 3 niba ubishaka. Buri wese muri mwe ahitamo ibara, kandi buri bara rifite izina ryaryo ryanditse n'ishusho yaryo. Mufata imvugo: mu mvugo yawe, kanda umwanya uri ubusa kugira ngo ushyireho agace kawe. Igihe buri mwanya wuzuye agace, ishusho iba yubatswe hamwe. Nta watsinze, kuko mukora nk'abantu babiri, kandi ntakibikwa cyangwa ngo cyoherezwe. "Caza akarere" ishyira akarere gasigaye ku rupapuro rumwe kugira ngo mwubake n'ikaramu ebyiri.
howTo: Buri wese muri mwe ahitamo ibara. Ibara umuntu mugenzi afite rigaragazwa ngo "Riri gukoreshwa".
Umuntu wa mbere ni we ukina mbere. Ecran yerekana ubwo ari umukino w'umuntu n'ibara rye.
Kanda umwanya uri ubusa kugira ngo ushyireho agace kawe. Umukino uhererekanywa ku wundi muntu.
Niba udashaka gushyiraho agace, kanda "Simbuka". Buri wese muri mwe ashobora gusimbuka igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
Igihe buri mwanya wuzuye agace, mwubatse ishusho hamwe. Kanda "Tangira bundi bushya" kugira ngo wubake indi, cyangwa kanda Ruhuka kugira ngo uhagarike.

Gerageza kubaka umurongo, imirongo, akarere k'amabara abiri ahinduranya cyangwa umupaka, cyangwa shyira udukingirizo aho ushaka hose. Byombi ni byiza.
Umwana cyangwa umuntu unaniwe vuba ashobora gusimbuka uko ashaka kose. Ishusho iracyubakwa hamwe.
Ku rupapuro, buri wese akoresha ikaramu imwe akareba ishusho ye mu nzirakarengane zirimo ubusa.

faq.q: Hari uwutsinda, isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta watsinda, kuko mwubaka ishusho imwe hamwe. Nta saha, amanota, kubara udukingirizo cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarika hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurangiza.

faq.q: Ibyo dukora bibikwa cyangwa byoherezwa?
faq.a: Oya. Akarere kaguma kuri uru rupapuro gusa. Ntikabikwa, ntikoherezwa cyangwa ngo kabarwe, kandi karazimira igihe ufunze urupapuro. Niba ushaka kukibika, caza akarere ukubake ku rupapuro.

faq.q: Niba nshyize agace ahantu habi fa?
faq.a: Nta hantu habi haba. Kanda "Subiza agace ka nyuma" maze umukino usubire kuri wowe. Ushobora gusubiza intambwe imwe imwe, kandi n'igihe wasimbutse gishobora gusubizwa.

Amabara ane yagenzuwe hakoreshejwe ibigereranyo by'ubumuga bwo kutamenya umutuku n'icyatsi n'ubumuga bw'ubururu n'umuhondo. Umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutamenya amabara ntarageragereza, nuko tubwire niba amabara abiri asa.

faq.q: Ese imyanya ihagije ku mikaka cyangwa kuri ecran nto?
faq.a: Buri mwanya ufite nibura pigiseli 56 z'ubugari. Niba akarere karenze ecran, karizunguruka iruhande mu gasanduku kacyo aho kugabanya imyanya.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku rupapuro?
faq.a: Yego. "Caza akarere" icapa akarere gasigaye ku rupapuro rumwe, hamwe n'amabara abiri n'amazina yayo, kugira ngo mubake n'ikaramu ebyiri. Ikora mu mukara n'umweru kuko buri bara rifite ishusho yaryo.

seated-toss.name: Kubara gutera wicaye
seated-toss.seoTitle: Kubara Gutera Wicaye: Umukino w'Umufuka w'Ibinyampeke ku Bantu Babiri
seated-toss.h1: Kubara Gutera Wicaye: Mutere Hamwe ku Meza
seated-toss.description: Abantu babiri bicaye ku meza bafata imvugo yo gutera umufuka woroshye w'ibinyampeke mu cyerekezo kinini, kandi bakandika amanota ku rupapuro. Nta gihe cyangwa amanota byandikwa. Ni ubuntu gucapa.
seated-toss.short: Fata imvugo wterere umufuka w'ibinyampeke ku cyerekezo kinini, amanota aba ku rupapuro.
seated-toss.intro: Umukino utuje wo gutera ku bantu babiri bicaye ku meza. Mushyira icyerekezo cyacapwe ku meza mugafata imvugo yo gutera umufuka woroshye w'ibinyampeke, cyangwa isogisi yazingiye, kugira ngo igwe ku mpeta. Buri wese muri mwe agira amanota abitswe mu kugira akamenyetso mu masanduku ku rupapuro, kandi mureba ibimenyetso hamwe igihe muhagaritse. Nta gihe gipimwa, nta kubarwa kuri ecran, kandi nta kibikwa cyangwa ngo cyoherezwe. Banza usome inyandiko z'umutekano: ibikoresho bito biri mu mifuka ni impanuka yo kumira.
howTo: Soma inyandiko z'umutekano. Hitamo umufuka ufunze neza, cyangwa zinga isogisi isukuye.
Kanda "Caza icyerekezo n'urupapuro rw'amanota" maze ushyire urupapuro hasi ku meza hagati yanyu.
Mwicare neza, umwe ku ruhande rumwe, undi ku rundi, mufata imvugo yo gutera rimwe rimwe. Buri wese ashobora gusimbuka.
Igihe gutera kugwa mu mpeta, shyiraho akamenyetso mu gasanduku ko mu nkingi yawe, ku murongo w'iyo mpeta.
Reba ibimenyetso hamwe igihe muhagaritse, cyangwa kanda Ruhuka kugira ngo muhagarike by'agateganyo.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Month
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for any month of the year: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. The page opens on this month, or choose another, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the month you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a month, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that month's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. The page opens on the current month of your device. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a month, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this month's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Chagua tukio, kisha ukandamize "Chapisha kadi".
Kunja karatasi katikati kwa kufuata mstari wenye vitone, ili upande wa mbele uwe nje.
Mtu mmoja anapamba upande wa mbele, na mwingine anapamba upande wa nyuma, au mnachukua zamu kwenye upande mmoja.
Andikeni ujumbe pamoja. Mmoja anaweza kuandika huku mwingine akitamka maneno.
Acha wakati wowote unapotaka. Kadi rahisi ni nzuri sawa na kadi yenye maelezo mengi.
tips: Anza kwa maneno ya mbele, kisha ongeza majani, nyota au vitone kuzunguka maneno, moja baada ya jingine.
Ikiwa mtu hapendi kuchora, anaweza kuchagua rangi au kuandika ujumbe.
Sema unachopenda kuhusu alama za mtu mwingine, badala ya kusema kama ni nzuri au la.
Weka kadi mahali ambapo inaweza kutolewa, au iache tu mezani kwa sasa.

faq.q: Kuna saa ya kupima muda au alama?
faq.a: Hapana. Hakuna saa, alama, kuhesabu hatua wala kushindwa. Unaweza kusimama wakati wowote, na kusimama katikati ni njia nzuri kabisa ya kumaliza.

faq.q: Tunahitaji gundi, mkasi au vibandiko?
faq.a: Hapana. Kalamu za rangi, penseli za rangi au kalamu za wino zinatosha. Hakuna haja ya kukata, kubandika wala kugundisha chochote.

faq.q: Je, tunaweza kutengeneza kadi kwa tukio ambalo halipo kwenye orodha?
faq.a: Chagua "Tu kwa sababu" kisha andika maneno yako mwenyewe mbele ya kadi, au pamba kadi bila tukio lolote.

faq.q: Je, kuna kitu kinachohesabiwa, kuhukumiwa au kuhifadhiwa kwenye skrini?
faq.a: Hapana. Ukurasa unaonyesha kadi na hatua tu. Hakuna kinachopangwa, kupewa alama wala kuhifadhiwa, na hakuna kadi sahihi.

faq.q: Nini kipo kwenye karatasi iliyochapishwa?
faq.a: Ukurasa mmoja: kadi iliyokunjwa katikati, yenye maneno ya tukio na fremu rahisi mbele, na mistari ya ujumbe na mstari wa Kutoka upande wa nyuma. Kanuni za watu wawili zimechapishwa chini.

faq.q: Je, ni bure, na ninahitaji kujisajili?
faq.a: Ndiyo, ni bure, na hakuna akaunti, usajili wala upakuaji. Inafanya kazi kwenye kivinjari cha wavuti kwenye simu, kompyuta kibao au kompyuta.

find-together.name: Tafuteni pamoja
find-together.seoTitle: Tafuteni Pamoja: Watu Wawili Wanatafuta Jozi
find-together.h1: Tafuteni Pamoja: Watu Wawili, Timu Moja
find-together.description: Watu wawili wanashiriki skrini moja na kuchukua zamu kugeuza kadi mbili za picha ili kutafuta jozi. Jozi zinapatikana pamoja na kuhesabiwa kwenye hesabu moja ya pamoja. Ni bure kucheza, bila saa wala alama.
find-together.short: Chukueni zamu na mtu aliye karibu nanyi kutafuta jozi za picha.
find-together.intro: Kadi zinaanza zikiwa zinaonyesha picha zao, au unaweza kuziweka zikitazama chini. Zamu yako ukifika, geuza kadi mbili. Zikiwa jozi, mmepata pamoja na zamu inapita. Zikiwa tofauti, zitabaki zikitazama juu hadi ubonyeze "Zirudishe chini", ili nyote mzitazame. Unaweza kupita wakati wowote. Hesabu iliyo juu huongezeka tu: jozi mlizopata pamoja.
howTo: Chagua kadi ngapi za kutumia. Kadi sita, yaani jozi tatu, ni mwanzo mzuri na wa utulivu.
Skrini inaonyesha zamu ya nani, kwa duara kwa mtu wa kwanza na mraba kwa mtu wa pili.
Geuza kadi mbili, moja baada ya nyingine. Zikilingana, jozi imepatikana pamoja.
Zikiwa tofauti, bonyeza "Zirudishe chini" mnapokuwa tayari nyote. Zamu basi inapita.
Mmoja wenu anaweza kubonyeza "Pita" wakati wowote. Gusa "Anza upya" kwa kadi mpya, au gusa Pumzika ili kusimama.
tips: Keti kando kwa kando na mtaje picha kwa sauti pamoja: "Kikombe cha chai. Je, unaweka maziwa kwenye chai yako?"
Acha mtu unayemjali ndiye agonge kadi, hata kama inachukua muda. Elekeza kwa kidole badala ya kugonga kwa ajili yake.
Chagua "Kadi zinatazama chini" ikiwa nyote mnafurahia kugeuza kadi ili kutafuta picha.
Mtu anayechoka haraka anaweza kupita mara nyingi apendavyo. Jozi bado zinapatikana pamoja.

faq.q: Kuna mshindi, saa au alama?
faq.a: Hapana. Hakuna mshindi, kwa sababu jozi mnazitafuta kama timu. Hakuna saa, alama wala kuhesabu makosa. Hesabu inahesabu jozi mlizopata pamoja tu, na unaweza kusimama wakati wowote.

faq.q: Je, lazima tukumbuke picha ziko wapi?
faq.a: Hapana. Mchezo unaanza na picha zote zikionekana. Kadi zikiwa zinatazama chini, mnaweza kuulizana mliona nini, au kuzigeuza tena tu.

faq.q: Nini kinatokea kadi mbili zikiwa tofauti?
faq.a: Zinabaki zikitazama juu, ili nyote mziangalie kwa muda wowote mnaohitaji. Hakuna kinachozigeuza tena chenyewe. Mnapokuwa tayari, bonyeza "Zirudishe chini" na zamu inapita kwa mtu mwingine.

faq.q: Je, chochote tunachocheza kinahifadhiwa au kutumwa?
faq.a: Hapana. Kadi zinabaki kwenye ukurasa huu tu. Hakuna kinachohifadhiwa, kupakiwa wala kuhesabiwa, na kinapotea mkifunga ukurasa.

faq.q: Je, kadi ni kubwa vya kutosha kwa mtetemeko wa mkono au skrini ndogo?
faq.a: Kila kadi ina upana wa angalau pikseli 64 na ni kubwa kadiri skrini inavyoruhusu. Watumiaji wa kibodi na wasomaji wa skrini husikia kila kadi kwa nafasi yake na picha yake.

faq.q: Je, ni bure, na ninahitaji kujisajili?
faq.a: Ndiyo, ni bure, na hakuna akaunti, usajili wala upakuaji. Inafanya kazi kwenye kivinjari cha wavuti kwenye simu, kompyuta kibao au kompyuta.

story-dice.name: Kete za hadithi
story-dice.seoTitle: Kete za Hadithi: Mchezo wa Kusimulia Hadithi kwa Picha
story-dice.h1: Kete za Hadithi: Simulia Hadithi kwa Picha
story-dice.description: Kete tatu au nne za picha za kusimulia hadithi, kwa mpangilio wowote. Hakuna kusoma, hakuna jibu sahihi, hakuna saa wala alama. Tupa tena, au pita. Ni bure kucheza na kuchapisha.
story-dice.short: Tupa kete za picha na msimulie hadithi pamoja, kwa mpangilio wowote.
story-dice.players: Watu 2 au zaidi, au mtu mzima na mtoto
story-dice.intro: Ikiribwe ry'amashusho atatu cyangwaane yerekanwa, nk'amakete. Hamwe, mwubake inkuru ikoresha ayo mashusho, mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose. Inkuru ishobora kuba interuro imwe cyangwa nyinshi, kandi ishobora kuba iseka cyangwa iy'ibintu bisanzwe mu buzima. Nta nkuru y'ukuri ihari, kandi nta muntu usabwa kugira izina avuga cyangwa kwibuka ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose. Kanda "Ongera uzunguze" ubone andi mashusho, kandi umuntu wese ashobora kwisubiraho.
howTo: Hitamo amakete atatu cyangwaane. Atatu ni yo yoroshye kurusha izindi.
Mureberere amashusho hamwe. Kanda rimwe niba ushaka gutangirira kuri ryo.
Mujye muvuga inkuru ikoresha amashusho, mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, buri wese ku isimbura undi. Interuro imwe buri wese biba bihagije.
Umuntu wese ashobora kwisubiraho. Kanda "Subira inyuma" maze undi muntu akomeze.
Kanda "Ongera uzunguze" igihe cyose ushaka andi mashusho, cyangwa kanda Ruhuka kugira ngo uhagarike.
tips: Baza ikibazo aho gutegereza igisubizo: "Umutaka ushobora kuba ujya he?"
Ongeraho ku byo uwavuze mbere yawe aho gukosora. Inkuru iyo ari yo yose irakwiriye.
Inkuru ishobora kuba ku bintu wibuka by'ukuri. Ishusho ni intangiriro nziza yayo.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imikino, kandi nta gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Ese ngomba gusoma cyangwa kuvuga amazina y'amashusho?
faq.a: Oya. Umukino ukora n'amashusho gusa. Abakina bashobora kuyerekana, kuyasobanura cyangwa kuvuga gusa icyo ishusho ibibutsa. Nta muntu usabwa kuvuga cyangwa kwibuka ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

faq.q: Ese se byagenda bite umuntu adashaka gufata ikiruhuko cye?
faq.a: Ashobora kwisubiraho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, nta mpamvu atanga. Umukino ritegereza gusa, kandi undi muntu ashobora gutangira cyangwa mukongera mukazunguza.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku mpapuro?
faq.a: Yego. Urupapuro rumwe rufite amashusho cumi na atandatu atandukanye mu mirongo ine. Hitamo umurongo, cyangwa ukate amashusho maze ukure bimwe mu cyumba cy'amashusho.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi ngomba kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo. Ikora mu mbuga ya interineti ku telefoni, ku tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Amagambo n'amashusho bihuye
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Amagambo n'Amashusho Bihuye: Huza Amagambo n'Amashusho
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Amagambo n'Amashusho Bihuye: Huza Ijambo n'Ishusho Ryaryo
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Huza amagambo y'Icyongereza n'amashusho yayo, kandi wumve ijambo iryo ari ryo ryose risomwa hejuru. Amashusho aguma arebwa, nta saha, nta manota cyangwa umubare w'ibigeragezo. Gukina no gucapa ni ubuntu.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Huza buri jambo n'ishusho yaryo, kandi uryumve risomwa hejuru.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Umuntu mukuru umwe, cyangwa umuryango ukina ku ruhande rumwe
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Amashusho ane cyangwa atandatu yerekanwa, n'amagambo yayo y'Icyongereza ari mu rundi rutonde. Kanda ijambo hanyuma ishusho yaryo, cyangwa ishusho hanyuma ijambo ryayo. Igikorwa cyahuye kigumana hamwe ku nkike ibyimbye, hakagaragaramo ijambo "Bihuye". Kanda "Soma hejuru" iruhande rw'ijambo iryo ari ryo ryose kugira ngo uryumve rivugwa. Nta gihe kibarwa, nta manota atangwa, kandi kanda idahuye yisubiraho yonyine.
howTo: Hitamo amashusho ane cyangwa atandatu. Ane ni yo yoroshye kurusha.
Kanda ijambo, hanyuma ishusho rivuga. Cyangwa kanda ishusho mbere, hanyuma ijambo ryayo.
Igikorwa cyahuye kigumana hamwe. Kanda idahuye ikisubiraho buhoro, bityo ugerageze indi.
Kanda "Soma hejuru" iruhande rw'ijambo kugira ngo uryumve, niba igikoresho cyawe gishobora gusoma inyandiko hejuru.
Kanda "Amashusho mashya" ushake urundi rutonde, cyangwa "Tangira bundi bushya" usenye ibihuye byose. "Subiza aho" izana ibihuye biheruka.
tips: Mubanze muvuge buri jambo hamwe mbere yo guhuza, kandi muvuge ku ishusho.
Imiryango ishobora gusimburana. Buri wese ahitamo ijambo cyangwa ishusho rimwe icyarimwe.
Banza ukoreshe amagambo usanzwe uzi, hanyuma ayandi uyasigire igihe kizaza.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imikino, kandi nta gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Ese ni ku bana?
faq.a: Yakozwe ku bantu bakuru biga cyangwa bongera kwiga amagambo y'Icyongereza, no ku miryango ikina ku ruhande rumwe. Ntiyanditswe ku bana.

faq.q: Byagenda bite igikoresho cyanjye kidashobora gusoma inyandiko hejuru?
faq.a: Buto ya "Soma hejuru" ikoresha ijwi umushakashatsi wawe asanzwe afite. Niba mushakashatsi adashobora kuvuga, buto ntigaragara kandi umukino ukora utayirimo.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku mpapuro?
faq.a: Yego. Urupapuro rumwe rufite amashusho atandatu n'amagambo yayo atandatu, bikaba bishobora gukatwa cyangwa guhuzwa n'umurongo.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi ngomba kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa gukuramo. Ikora mu mbuga ya interineti ku telefoni, ku tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

sort-together.name: Tondeka hamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Umukino wo Gutondeka: Tondeka hamwe ku bantu bakuru
sort-together.h1: Tondeka hamwe: igikorwa cyo gutondeka amafoto
sort-together.description: Kanda ishusho, hanyuma igiseke ribereye: igikoni cyangwa ubusitani, imbuto cyangwa inyamaswa. Umukino utuje kandi w'ubuntu wo gutondeka ku bantu bakuru n'imiryango.
sort-together.short: Shyira buri shusho mu gaseke kayo: igikoni cyangwa ubusitani, n'ibindi.
sort-together.intro: Gutondeka ni igikorwa cyo buri munsi kizwi kandi gishimisha, nk'igihe usubiza ibintu mu kabati cyangwa uhuza amasogisi. Kanda ishusho, hanyuma ukande agaseke ishusho ikwiriye. Nta gihe cyo kwihutira kandi nta kosa ryo kuvaho.
howTo: Hitamo insanganyamatsiko: igikoni n'ubusitani, imbuto n'inyamaswa, cyangwa urugo n'ingendo.
Kanda ishusho. Ihita ibona umupaka wa zahabu.
Kanda agaseke ishusho ikwiriye. Ishusho yimukira muri ako gaseke.
Niba ikwiriye mu kandi gaseke, umukino ubivuga mu bworoherane kandi ugategereza.
Ishusho zose zimaze gutondekwa, reba utugaseke hamwe.
tips: Mu buzima busanzwe nta gisubizo kibi kiba gihari. Niba umuntu avuga ko ikibindi cyo kuhira kiri mu gikoni, mubaze impamvu. Ushobora kumva inkuru nziza.
Koresha amashusho nk'ikibazo: “Wateye iki mu busitani bwawe?”
Gutondeka ibintu nyabyo, nk'ibiyiko n'amasahane cyangwa utubuto dukurikije ibara, ni igikorwa cyiza gikurikira hanze ya ecran.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta mubare w'intambwe cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Kuki gutondeka?
faq.a: Abantu benshi bishimira gutondeka kuko bisa n'akazi gakenewe kandi kazwi. Ni nanone byoroshye kuganira ku mashusho uko mugenda.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi ni ngombwa kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora mu mushakisha w'urubuga kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzzle y'ishusho
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Puzzle yo Kuri Interineti Yoroshye: Ibice 4 cyangwa 9 binini
picture-puzzle.description: Puzzle yo kuri interineti yoroshye ku bantu bakuru: ibice 4 cyangwa 9 binini, ishusho yose iguma igaragara, kandi ukanda ibice bibiri kugira ngo ubihindure aho biri. Koresha ifoto yawe bwite, iguma kuri iki gikoresho. Ni ubuntu, nta saha.
picture-puzzle.short: Kanda ibice bibiri kugira ngo bihindure aho biri kugeza ishusho yuzuye.
picture-puzzle.intro: Ishusho nziza icibwamo ibice bine cyangwa icyenda binini kandi igahinduka. Ishusho yose iguma igaragara nk'umuyobozi. Kanda igice kimwe, hanyuma ikindi, bahindurane aho biri. Nta kwimura bikenewe. Nanone ushobora gukoresha imwe mu mafoto yawe. Iguma kuri iki gikoresho kandi ntiyoherezwa ahandi na rimwe.
howTo: Hitamo ishusho n'ibice 4 cyangwa 9. Ine ni intangiriro yoroshye.
Reba ishusho yose iri hejuru.
Kanda igice, hanyuma ukande aho kigomba kujya. Ibice bibiri birahinduranya.
Ibice biri aho bikwiriye bihabwa akamenyetso gato k'igenzura.
Ishusho imaze kuzura, mujye mwishimira hamwe, hanyuma muhitemo indi.
tips: Gukanda ibice bibiri kugira ngo bihindure aho biri biroroha cyane kuri benshi kuruta kwikurura.
Vugana ku ishusho uko igenda ihuzwa: “Dore inzu y'amabara atukura.”
Puzzle y'ibiti nyayo ifite ibice 12 kugeza ku 24 binini na yo ni igikorwa cyiza ku meza.

faq.q: Ni ngombwa kwikurura ibice?
faq.a: Oya. Kanda igice kimwe, hanyuma ikindi, bahinduranya aho biri. Ibi biroroha iyo ukuboko kunyeganyega cyangwa ecran ari ntoya.

faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora mu mushakisha w'urubuga kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

finish-the-saying.name: Uzuza umugani
finish-the-saying.description: Imigani izwi cyane ifite ijambo ry'iherezo ryabuze. Kanda igisubizo cyangwa werekane iherezo, hanyuma muganire ku migani.
finish-the-saying.short: Uzuza imigani izwi hamwe, hanyuma muganire ku yo.
finish-the-saying.intro: Imigani ya kera akenshi iba izwi mu buzima bwose. Buri karita yerekana umugani uzwi ufite ijambo ry'iherezo ryabuze, amahitamo atatu, n'buto “Erekana iherezo”. Iherezo rimaze kugaragara, ikibazo cyoroheje gitumira ikiganiro.
howTo: Soma umugani hamwe ku ijwi rirenga.
Kanda ijambo risoza, cyangwa ukande “Erekana iherezo”.
Soma umugani wose ukundi, hanyuma muganire ku kibazo cyatanzwe.
Kanda “Umugani ukurikira” igihe witeguye.
tips: Soma buhoro kandi usige akanya mbere y'ijambo rya nyuma. Akenshi abantu bavuga ijambo mbere yuko urangiza.
Niba umuntu atanze iherezo ritandukanye, rikunde. Imigani imwe iratandukana bitewe n'umuryango cyangwa akarere.
Mu itsinda, umuntu umwe asoma, abandi bose bifatanya mu kuvuga iherezo.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imikino, nta gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarika hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Byagenda bite twatoranyije ijambo ritandukanye?
faq.a: Umukino werekana umusozo usanzwe hanyuma ugakomeza ku kiganiro. Nta manota arimo, kandi igisubizo gitandukanye ni cyiza.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi bisaba kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo porogaramu. Gikora mu rubuga rwa internet kuri telefoni, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

word-search.name: Umukino w'amagambo wanditse mu nyuguti nini
word-search.seoTitle: Ishakisha ry'Amagambo ku Nyandiko Nini, ku Buntu no Gucapa
word-search.h1: Umukino w'Amagambo wanditse mu Nyuguti Nini
word-search.description: Ishakisha ry'amagambo ku nyandiko nini ku bantu bakuru n'imiryango, ku buntu. Amagambo make, inyuguti nini, amagambo agenda uhereye ibumoso ugana iburyo cyangwa uhereye hejuru ugana hasi gusa. Kina kuri interineti cyangwa ucapishe.
word-search.short: Inyuguti nini, amagambo make, asomwa iburyo cyangwa hasi gusa. Ushobora no kuwucapa.
word-search.intro: Akarango gato k'inyuguti nini n'amagambo make gusa, yose asomwa iburyo cyangwa hasi. Kanda inyuguti ya mbere y'ijambo, hanyuma ukande iya nyuma. Ukunda impapuro? Capisha umukino mushya mu kanda imwe.
howTo: Hitamo insanganyamatsiko n'ingano y'akarango.
Reba urutonde rw'amagambo. Amagambo asomwa iburyo (ibumoso ugana iburyo) cyangwa hasi (hejuru ugana hasi).
Kanda inyuguti ya mbere y'ijambo, hanyuma ukande iya nyuma.
Ijambo ryabonetse rirasurwa kandi rikurwa ku rutonde.
Kanda "Capisha iki gikino" ukine ku mpapuro ukoresheje ikaramu cyangwa irangi.
tips: Reba ijambo ku rutonde, hanyuma mushakire hamwe inyuguti yaryo ya mbere.
Ku mpapuro, ikaramu y'irangi yoroshye gufata kurusha ikaramu isanzwe.
Muvugane ku magambo y'insanganyamatsiko. Amagambo y'imbuto ni uburyo bwiza bwo kwibuka gusoroma, guteka cyangwa isoko.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imikino, nta gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarika hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Ese nshobora gucapa umukino w'amagambo?
faq.a: Yego. Kanda "Capisha iki gikino" ucapishe akarango kariho ubu mu nyuguti nini, munsi hari urutonde rw'amagambo. Buri gikino gishya kiba gitandukanye.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi bisaba kwiyandikisha?

coloring.name: Amapaji yo gusiga amabara
coloring.seoTitle: Amapaji yo Gushushanya ku Bantu Bakuru, Manini kandi Yoroshye, ku Buntu
coloring.description: Amapaji yoroheje y'abakuze, afite ahantu hanini: kanda ibara, hanyuma ukande ishusho. Nta kwanduranya, nta mabara 'mabi', kandi buri paji ushobora kuyicapa ku buntu.
coloring.short: Kanda ibara, hanyuma ukande igice cy'ishusho. Ushobora no gucapa amapaji.
coloring.intro: Amapaji afite ishusho nini kandi yoroheje: igiti cy'indabo mu nkono, inzu, igikombe cy'icyayi, ikinyugunyugu n'ubwato bwo mu nyanja. Kanda ibara, hanyuma ukande igice cy'ishusho kugira ngo ugisige. Nta mabara 'mabi' ahari.

Kanda ibara. Buri bara ryanditseho izina ryaryo.
Kanda igice cy'ishusho kugira ngo ugisige iryo bara.
Igihe cyose wahindura igitekerezo, ongera ugisige ibindi.

tips: Niba guhitamo bigoye, tanga amabara abiri gusa aho kuba urutonde rwose.

Amapaji acapishijwe akoranwa neza n'amakaramu manini cyangwa amarangi, byoroshye gufata.

conversation-cards.name: Amakarita yo kuganira
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Gutangira ibiganiro: Amakarita y'amashusho ku miryango
conversation-cards.description: Amakarita y'amashusho afite ibibazo byoroheje byo gutangira ibiganiro ku miryango, ku nshuti n'abakuru, harimo n'abantu babana n'indwara ya dementia. Nta bibazo bisaba ibisubizo by'ukuri cyangwa ibibi.
conversation-cards.short: Amakarita y'amashusho afite ibibazo bifunguye kandi byoroheje. Nta kubaza ibibazo bikomeye.
conversation-cards.intro: Buri karita ihuza ishusho rimenyerewe n'ikibazo gifunguye cyo kuganiraho, nk'"Ni ubuhe bwoko bw'ikirere ukunda?" Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri gihari kandi nta kintu cyo kwibuka. Hitamo insanganyamatsiko cyangwa uvange amakarita yose.
howTo: Hitamo insanganyamatsiko, cyangwa ukomeze "Amakarita yose".
Soma ikibazo hejuru y'ijwi, hanyuma murebe ishusho hamwe.
Tega amatwi, tanga igisubizo cyawe, kandi reka ikiganiro kigende uko kiri.
Kanda "Karita ikurikira" igihe witeguye, cyangwa ukomeze ku karita imwe igihe cyose ushaka.
Kanda "Capisha amakarita yose" ubone amakarita yo gutema ku mpapuro.
tips: Nawe subiza ikibazo. Bituma biba ikiganiro aho kuba ibazwa.
Kurikira inkuru, aho kwitegereza ukuri. Niba ibisobanuro bihindutse, nta kibazo.
Niba karita ikoza ku kintu gihungabanya, emera ibyiyumvo, hanyuma wimukire buhoro ku yindi karita.

faq.q: Kuki nta bibazo bya "Wibuka…?" bihari?
faq.a: Ibibazo bipima kwibuka bishobora kumera nk'ikizamini kandi bikagira isoni. Ibyifuzo bifunguye nka "Mbwira ku…" bituma umuntu wese yinjira mu kiganiro, uko yibuka kose.

faq.q: Ese nshobora gucapa amakarita?
faq.a: Yego. "Capisha amakarita yose" icapisha amakarita yose mu nyuguti nini, amakarita menshi kuri paji imwe, ateguwe gutemwa.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi bisaba kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo porogaramu. Ikora mu mushakisha wa interineti ku telefone, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

photo-pairs.name: Amafoto ahuje
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Kora Umukino wo Guhuza Amafoto y'Umuryango
photo-pairs.description: Hindura amafoto y'umuryango wawe umukino woroshye wo guhuza. Hitamo amafoto 2 kugeza kuri 6 ku gikoresho cyawe; agumana muri mushakisha yawe kandi ntiyoherezwa ahandi.
photo-pairs.short: Hitamo amafoto yawe uyahuze. Nta na rimwe yoherezwa.
photo-pairs.players: Abantu 2, bicaye iruhande rwa mugenzi wabo
photo-pairs.intro: Hitamo amafoto abiri kugeza kuri atandatu y'umuryango wawe ku telefoni, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa, maze ahinduke umukino wo guhuza amashusho manini kandi agaragara neza. Amafoto agaragara gusa muri uru rupapuro. Ntiyoherezwa, ntabikwa cyangwa ngo asangizwe, kandi azimira igihe ufunze urupapuro. Niba ubishaka, wandikaho amagambo make munsi ya buri foto, kandi inama yoroheje ishobora kwerekana kimwe mu bihuza nyuma y'akanya gato. Ni uburyo bwo kureba amafoto y'umuryango hamwe.
howTo: Kanda “Hitamo amafoto” uhitemo amafoto abiri kugeza kuri atandatu.
Buri foto igaragara inshuro ebyiri. Kanda imwe, hanyuma ukande indi ifitanye na yo.
Niba ubishaka, wandikaho amagambo make munsi ya buri foto. Amagambo ntabikwa.
Vugana ku buri foto uko uyibonye.
Nurangiza, funga urupapuro cyangwa ukande “Siba amafoto”. Nta kintu kibikwa.
tips: Hitamo amafoto asobanutse y'ibintu bishimishije kandi bimenyerewe: itungo, ubusitani, ahantu ukunda, umunsi w'ubukwe.
Amafoto y'ahantu n'ibintu ashobora koroha kurusha amaso y'abantu, kandi ntiyongera igitutu cyo kuvuga amazina y'abantu.
Ushobora kwirinda amafoto y'abantu bapfuye niba ashobora kubateza agahinda gatunguranye, keretse uzi ko ayo mafoto amuhumuriza.

faq.q: Amafoto yanjye arohererezwa ahandi hose?
faq.a: Oya. Paji isoma amafoto wahisemo mu mushakisha wawe ikayerekana kuri ecran yawe. Ntiyoherezwa kuri twe cyangwa ku wundi muntu, kandi ashira igihe ufunze cyangwa wongeye gupakira paji.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta isaha, nta manota, nta kubara ingendo cyangwa gutsindwa. Ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi guhagarara hagati nabyo ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusoza.

faq.q: Nshobora kubika umukino wo ku wundi munsi?
faq.a: Ntabwo mu mushakisha, kuko byateguwe gutyo kugira ngo nta makuru yihariye abikwa. Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Creative Activities ya iPhone na iPad ishobora kubika kopi z'amafoto wahisemo ku gikoresho cyawe.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo y'amafoto
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Umukino wa bingo y'amashusho wo gucapa ku matsinda
picture-bingo.description: Umukino wa bingo y'amashusho wo gucapa, ku buntu, ku miryango, ku matsinda y'abakuru n'ku bigo bita ku bantu. Amashusho manini afite amagambo, udukarita 9 cyangwa 16, n'umuhamagaro mugari ugaragara kuri ecran.
picture-bingo.short: Amakarita ya bingo y'amafoto yo gucapa n'umuhamagaro munini ku matsinda.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo isanzwe, ariko aho kuba imibare hakaba amafoto, ku buryo ntawe ukeneye gusoma inyandiko nto. Capa amakarita atandukanye, hanyuma ukoreshe umuhamagaro wo kuri ecran werekane buri foto ari nini kuri televiziyo, mudasobwa cyangwa tabuleti.
howTo: Hitamo udukari 9 cyangwa 16 ku ikarita imwe, n'umubare w'abakinnyi.
Kanda "Capa amakarita". Buri karita iba itandukanye.
Fungura umuhamagaro ku ecran nini. Kanda "Ifoto ikurikira" werekane buri foto n'izina ryayo.
Abakinnyi bapfuka ifoto ihuje ku ikarita yabo bakoresheje ikimenyetso, buto cyangwa ikaramu.
Umuntu wese wuzuza umurongo, cyangwa ikarita yose, arashimirwa. Muri iyi verisiyo nta watsinzwe: mukomeze gukina kugeza buri wese agize umurongo.
tips: Koresha ibikoresho binini nk'udutabo two gukinisha cyangwa udupfundikizo twa icupa. Utubuto duto bishobora kugorana gufata.
Vuga izina ry'ifoto kandi uvuge ikintu kuri yo: "Ubwato bwo mu nyanja. Ni nde wigeze agenda mu bwato?"
Icara abafite ikibazo cyo kureba hafi ya ecran, kandi uhuze abafasha n'abakinnyi bakeneye ubufasha.
Udukari 9 birahagije ku matsinda menshi. Shyira igihe cy'umukino hafi iminota 20 kugeza kuri 30.

faq.q: Nkora nte bingo y'amafoto mu kigo cyita ku bantu?
faq.a: Capa ikarita imwe ku mukinnyi wese, shyira umuhamagaro kuri ecran nini kurusha izindi ufite, kandi uhamagare amafoto buhoro, uvuga izina rya buri imwe. Kina kugeza buri wese agize umurongo, kugira ngo ntawe usigara inyuma.

faq.q: Ese gucapa ni ubuntu?
faq.a: Yego. Capa amakarita angana n'ayo ukeneye, inshuro zose ushaka, ku bw'ikoreshwa ryawe bwite cyangwa ry'itsinda.

faq.q: Abantu bashobora gukina batasoma?
faq.a: Yego. Buri kibanza ni ifoto nini, hamwe n'izina ryayo munsi yayo ku bakunda amagambo.

picnic-planner.name: Gutegura pikiniki
picnic-planner.h1: Gutegura pikiniki: Hitamo amashusho, hanyuma uyahuze
picnic-planner.description: Hitamo amashusho y'ibiribwa n'ibikorwa byo gukora kuri pikiniki, hanyuma ukine umukino woroshye wo guhuza. Nta gihe gipimwa. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapa.
picnic-planner.short: Hitamo amashusho y'ibiribwa n'ibikorwa bya pikiniki, hanyuma uyahuze.
picnic-planner.players: Wenyine, cyangwa abantu 2 bicaye iruhande rumwe
picnic-planner.intro: Kanda amashusho y'ibiribwa n'ibikorwa ushaka gukora kugira ngo ajye mu gitebo cya pikiniki, gishobora gufata bitandatu. Interuro mu magambo ivuga ibiri mu gitebo, nka “Pikiniki yacu: umugati, foromaje, pome n'ikite.” Hanyuma kanda “Reka dukine na pikiniki yacu” kugira ngo habeho umukino woroshye wo guhuza ukoresheje amashusho watoranyije. Amashusho akomeza kugaragara, kandi nta gihe gipimwa, nta manota atangwa, nta kintu kibikwa. “Capa urutonde rwa pikiniki yacu” icapa urutonde rw'ibyo watoranyije, hamwe n'agasanduku ko kugenzura ku kintu cyose cyo gupakira.
howTo: Kanda ishusho y'ibiribwa cyangwa y'ikintu cyo gukora. Ijya mu gitebo.
Kanda ishusho iri mu gitebo kugira ngo uyikure mu gitebo.
Hitamo nibura ibintu bibiri, hanyuma ukande “Reka dukine na pikiniki yacu”.
Kanda amashusho abiri asa. Amashusho akomeza kugaragara, ku buryo nta kintu usabwa kwibuka.
Kanda “Capa urutonde rwa pikiniki yacu” ugire urutonde rwo ku mpapuro rwo kujyana.
tips: Baza abantu muri kumwe icyo bashaka kuzana, hanyuma mutoranye amashusho hamwe.
Vugana ku buri shusho uko rishyirwa mu gitebo: “Urabuka ikite twagurukishije ku mucanga?”
Ku mpapuro, imirongo yera ni iy'ibindi wifuza kuzana, cyangwa iy'izina.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyo gupima, amanota cyangwa umutsinzi?
faq.a: Oya. Nta gihe gipimwa cyangwa ngo kibarwe, kandi nta muntu utsinda. Umukino wo guhuza nta makosa n'amanota ugira.

faq.q: Ni gahunda y'ibiryo?
faq.a: Oya. Ni gahunda y'amashusho y'urugendo, yo kuganiraho no kujyana ku mpapuro. Ntivuga icyo umuntu agomba kurya.

faq.q: Amashusho dutoranya abikwa cyangwa yoherezwa?
faq.a: Oya. Igitebo kiguma kkuri uru rupapuro gusa. Ntikibikwa, ntikoherezwa cyangwa ngo cyoherezwe, kandi kizimira igihe ufunze urupapuro.

faq.q: Hari verisiyo yo ku mpapuro?
faq.a: Yego. “Capa urutonde rwa pikiniki yacu” icapa urupapuro rumwe, kuri A4 cyangwa US Letter. Rwerekana amashusho watoranyije, hamwe n'agasanduku ko kugenzura kuri buri shusho, n'imirongo yera y'ibindi bintu.

faq.q: Ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo. Ikora mu mushakisha w'interineti kuri telefoni, kuri tabuleti cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.

scrapbook.name: Igitabo cy'amafoto
scrapbook.seoTitle: Igitabo cy'amafoto: Reba amafoto y'umuryango hamwe, urupapuro ku rupapuro
scrapbook.h1: Igitabo cy'amafoto: Shyiramo amafoto n'amagambo, hanyuma ufungure impapuro
scrapbook.description: Hitamo amafoto abiri kugeza kuri cumi n'abiri y'umuryango wawe ku gikoresho cyawe, uyashyire mu gitabo, hamwe n'amagambo make munsi ya buri foto. Nta kintu cyoherezwa. Ni ubuntu gucapa.
scrapbook.short: Reba amafoto y'umuryango wawe hamwe, nk'igitabo.
scrapbook.players: Wenyine, cyangwa abantu 2 bicaye iruhande rumwe
scrapbook.intro: Hitamo amafoto abiri kugeza kuri cumi n'abiri yawe kuri iki gikoresho. Buri foto iba urupapuro rumwe rw'igitabo, rugaragara neza, hamwe n'amagambo make ubishaka munsi yarwo. Fungura impapuro ukoresheje buto cyangwa imyambi y'ibumoso n'iy'iburyo, kandi ukoreshe “Reba hamwe” kugira ngo mwicare iruhande rumwe, mureba amafoto n'amagambo gusa. Amafoto yawe aguma kuri iki gikoresho. Ntiyoherezwa cyangwa ngo abikwe, kandi igitabo kizimira igihe ufunze urupapuro. “Capa igitabo cy'amafoto” icapa ifoto imwe n'amagambo yayo kuri buri rupapuro, hamwe n'imibare y'impapuro.

Shyiramo amagambo make munsi y'ifoto niba ubishaka. Koresha “Mugire mbere” cyangwa “Mugire inyuma” uhindure uko zikurikirana.
Kanda “Reba hamwe” kugira ngo uhishe ibikoresho byo guhindura, maze mureba igitabo mwicaye iruhande rumwe.
Kanda “Capa igitabo cy'amafoto” ugire kopi yo ku mpapuro, cyangwa “Siba igitabo” nurangiza. Nta kintu kibikwa.
tips: Chagua amafoto y'ibintu bishimishije kandi bimenyerewe: ubusitani, itungo ry'inka, cyangwa ahantu mukunda. Muvugane ku ifoto yose mugiye gucisha ku rindi.
Mureke uwo mwitaho avuge amagambo make kuri buri rupapuro, ndetse n'ijambo rimwe gusa, maze mubyandike uko abivuze.
Ku mpapuro, impapuro zacapishijwe zishobora gushyirwa mu gikapu, kandi umuryango ushobora kongeraho amafoto n'amagambo yawo hafi yazo.

faq.q: Hari igihe cyo kubarira, amanota cyangwa uwatsinze?
faq.a: Oya. Nta gihe kibarwa, nta manota atangwa, kandi nta wutsinda. Nimero y'urupapuro iba ihari gusa kugira ngo mumenye aho mugeze mu gitabo.

faq.q: Amafoto yacu cyangwa amagambo yacu arabikwa, ashyirwa hanze cyangwa yoherezwa?
faq.a: Oya. Amafoto asomwa n'iyi paji gusa, ntashyirwa hanze, ntabikwa, kandi ntiyoherezwa ahandi hose. Amagambo ahabwa agakomeza kubikwa gusa igihe paji iri gufunguye. Iyo mufunze paji, igitabo kirazimira.

faq.q: Dushobora gucapisha igitabo?
faq.a: Yego. "Print the scrapbook" icapisha ifoto imwe n'amagambo yayo ku rupapuro rwose, hamwe n'imibare y'impapuro. Hitamo A4 cyangwa US Letter mu idirishya ryo gucapa.

collage-board.description: Abantu babiri bahererekanya gushyira amafoto yaciwe ku kibaho gisangiwe. Kanda ifoto yaciwe, hanyuma ahantu hasigaye hadafite ifoto. Nta gihe cyo kubarira cyangwa amanota. Ni ubuntu gukina no gucapisha.
collage-board.short: Muhererekanye gushyira amafoto ku kibaho kimwe gisangiwe.
collage-board.intro: Abantu babiri bicara iruhande rw'undi, hari ikibaho gifite ahantu cumi n'abiri hamwe n'agasanduku karimo amafoto cumi n'atandatu yaciwe. Umuntu wese ashobora kwimura umwanya we, kandi intambwe imwe ishobora gusubizwa inyuma. Nta gihe kibarwa, nta manota, nta kubikwa. faq.q: Amafoto dushyira ku kibaho arabikwa cyangwa yoherezwa?
faq.a: Oya. Ikibaho kigumira kuri iyi paji gusa. Ntigikizwa, ntigishyirwa hanze, ntikibarwa, kandi kirazimira igihe mufunze paji.

garden-planner.short: Hitamo amafoto y'ibimera, utegure ubusitani bugizwe n'ibitanda cumi n'bibiri.

Nta gihe kibarwa, nta manota, nta kubikwa, kandi nta mwanya uhererekanywa. Iyi ni gahunda y'amafoto yo kuganiraho, si inama z'ubuhinzi. "Print the plan" icapisha ibitanda hamwe n'amafoto mwahisemo, hamwe n'ibitanda bisigaye ubusa byo gushushanyamo n'imirongo yo kwandikamo.
